title: Smart Data Models - TM Forum Open APIs - ApiProduct
description: ApiProduct is a specialization of a Product being an instance of an atomic ProductOffering or a ProductSpecification that is realized by an API (the Service). (TM Forum TMF931 Open Gateway Operate API Onboarding and Ordering 5.2.1, OpenAPI component ApiProduct; attribute names kept verbatim except the NGSI-LD reserved terms / JSON-LD keywords renamed with a tmf prefix (id, @type, @baseType, @schemaLocation, ...); deprecated attributes left out.)

productOffering.description: Relationship. Model:'https://github.com/tmforum-apis/TMF931_OpenGatewayOnboardingAndOrderingComponentSuite/blob/v5.2.1/TMF931-Open_Gateway_Operate_API_Onboarding_and_Ordering-v5.2.1.oas.yaml#/components/schemas/ApiProduct/properties/productOffering'. ProductOffering reference. A product offering represents entities that are orderable from the provider of the catalog, this resource includes pricing information. In TMF this is a ProductOfferingRef object; here the NGSI-LD id of the referenced ProductOffering entity (urn:ngsi-ld:ProductOffering:<tmf id>). Inline values and reference metadata (href, name, @referredType) are not kept.
